title: NASA Spacecraft Mission Design Resource Catalog

extraction.scope: All explicit HTTP(S) citations, plus separately listed NASA resource names lacking a direct link, in the supplied Markdown document.
extraction.deduplication: One record per exact cited URL after removing its fragment. Retain original URL fragments, labels and every citation occurrence. Distinct paths and legacy addresses remain separate.
extraction.editorial_metadata: IDs, resource types, categories and descriptions organize the supplied reference. Titles and citation labels preserve its wording; descriptions and caveats summarize that document, not independently opened web pages.
extraction.unlinked_mentions: Named resources without a direct citation URL are listed separately. Related resource IDs identify starting points actually linked in the document, not inferred endpoints.

verification.note: Domain hosting does not establish who produced every underlying value. Confirm producer, version, conditions, units, uncertainty and applicable terms at the original source before accepting scientific inputs. Source review dates and program-status notes are statements from the supplied reference.
